$comment: HalaEvents playbook. Validated by PlaybookSchema (src/modules/ai/playbook.ts). The 'why' and description texts are planning prompts written by the HalaEvents team, not legal requirements or verified sources. Bump 'version' when a question's meaning changes.
title: University hackathon

principles: A venue cancellation does not cancel any other booking. Catering, transport, AV and other contracts differ: mark them for review or reconfirmation and ask the provider.
Never state that a replacement venue is available, that a provider agreed, or that a permit or clearance carries over, unless that party has said so.
Prices come only from quotes on record. If there is no quote, say the price is unknown.
Anything sent to attendees or providers is a draft until an organizer approves the exact text.
Keep dependent tasks in order: move a task only when the work it waits for moves.

ask: Do the delivery address, kitchen access and timing depend on the original venue?
What do your terms say about a change of location or date?
Does your equipment list and set-up time still fit a different room?
What are your terms for a change of location or date?
Do pick-up and drop-off points change with the venue?
What are your terms for a change of route or date?
Does the security plan depend on the original venue's layout or access rules?

questionsForReplacementVenue: Are the event dates and hours free, and can you hold them while we decide?
What capacity, power, Wi-Fi and overnight rules apply?
What are the access, loading and accessibility arrangements?
What are your cancellation and change terms?
accessAndComplianceNotes: Venue-related permissions and venue-policy checks that were cleared for the original venue need to be reassessed for the new one.
Access arrangements (entry, accessibility, loading, parking) are venue-specific and unknown for a new venue until the venue answers.

questions.why: Decides whether age checks, guardian consent and supervision tasks are part of the plan.

questions.text: What is the minimum participant age?
questions.why: Participants under 18 usually need guardian consent and supervision arrangements.

questions.text: Who will collect guardian consent for participants under 18?
questions.why: Consent collection becomes a task that must finish before participants are accepted.

options.label: We will, through the registration form

questions.text: Will students from other universities or schools take part?
questions.why: External participants may need campus access passes and a contact at the host institution.

questions.text: What is the maximum team size?
questions.why: Sets the registration form, judging slots and seating plan.

questions.text: Will participants stay at the venue overnight?
questions.why: Overnight events need rest areas, overnight security and a supervision rota.

questions.text: How will participants under 18 be supervised overnight?
questions.why: Overnight supervision of minors has to be arranged and named before the event.

questions.text: Will the hackathon take place on a university campus?
questions.why: Campus venues are usually booked through the university's facilities office.

questions.text: Where is the campus venue booking?
questions.why: The venue booking is a dependency for most other tasks. HalaEvents records your answer; it doesn't check with the university.

options.label: Confirmed in writing by the university

questions.text: Which platform will online participants use?
questions.why: The platform decides how links are sent and who sets up the online rooms.

questions.text: Will you provide food and drinks?
questions.why: Adds catering tasks and lets you request catering quotes from the marketplace.

questions.text: Which dietary needs must the catering cover?
questions.why: Goes into catering requests and the registration form.
Prizes add judging criteria, a prize budget and announcement tasks.
Cash and sponsor-provided prizes may need payment arrangements and sponsor agreements.
Adds sponsor outreach, branding and agreement tasks.

questions.text: Who will own the projects built at the hackathon?
questions.why: Ownership terms belong in the participant agreement before registration opens.

questions.text: Will you photograph or film participants?
questions.why: Participants should know about photography in advance.

questions.text: How will you collect photo consent?
questions.why: Consent wording becomes part of the registration form; minors' images usually need guardian consent.

questions.text: Will the registration form ask about accessibility needs?
questions.why: Answers feed venue access checks and on-the-day support tasks.

taskTemplates.title: Confirm hackathon scope and theme
taskTemplates.description: Agree the theme, format, team size and success criteria with the organizing team.
taskTemplates.nextAction: Hold a kickoff meeting and write down the theme and format.

taskTemplates.title: Set the event budget
taskTemplates.description: Draft a budget covering venue, catering, prizes, swag and contingency.
taskTemplates.nextAction: Draft budget lines and get sign-off from the sponsor or department.

taskTemplates.title: Book the campus venue
taskTemplates.description: Request the room or hall through the university facilities office and get the booking confirmed in writing.
taskTemplates.nextAction: Send the booking request to the facilities office with dates and expected attendance.

taskTemplates.title: Source an external venue
taskTemplates.description: Shortlist and request quotes from venues that fit the expected attendance and dates.
taskTemplates.nextAction: Shortlist venues in the marketplace and request quotes.

taskTemplates.title: Set up the online platform
taskTemplates.description: Create the online rooms, test access and write joining instructions.
taskTemplates.nextAction: Create a test room and run a joining test with two people.

taskTemplates.title: Write the participant agreement
taskTemplates.description: Write the participation terms, including project ownership, code of conduct and photo consent wording.
taskTemplates.nextAction: Draft the agreement and get it reviewed by the university or sponsor contact.

taskTemplates.title: Set up guardian consent
taskTemplates.description: Prepare the guardian consent form and decide how signed forms are collected and checked before acceptance.
taskTemplates.nextAction: Draft the consent form and agree with schools who collects it.

taskTemplates.title: Open registration
taskTemplates.description: Publish the registration form with team, dietary, accessibility and consent questions.
taskTemplates.nextAction: Build the registration form and test it end to end.

taskTemplates.title: Arrange campus access for external participants
taskTemplates.description: Agree visitor passes or guest lists with campus security for participants from other institutions.
taskTemplates.nextAction: Ask campus security what they need for visitor access.

taskTemplates.title: Book catering
taskTemplates.description: Request catering quotes that cover the dietary needs and confirm the order with the caterer.
taskTemplates.nextAction: Request quotes from two or three caterers in the marketplace.

taskTemplates.title: Plan the overnight period
taskTemplates.description: Arrange rest areas, overnight security and a supervision rota.
taskTemplates.nextAction: List overnight needs and confirm security cover with the venue.

taskTemplates.title: Write the safety and first-aid plan
taskTemplates.description: Name the first-aid contact, emergency procedure, evacuation route and incident reporting route.
taskTemplates.nextAction: Ask the venue for its emergency procedure and first-aid arrangements.

taskTemplates.title: Reach out to sponsors
taskTemplates.description: Prepare a sponsor pack and contact potential sponsors.

taskTemplates.title: Arrange prizes and judging
taskTemplates.description: Confirm prizes, judging criteria and judges.
taskTemplates.nextAction: Write the judging criteria and invite judges.

taskTemplates.title: Arrange photography
taskTemplates.description: Brief the photographer and make sure consent preferences are visible on the day.
taskTemplates.nextAction: Book a photographer or volunteer and share the consent list.

taskTemplates.title: Send participant briefing
taskTemplates.description: Send accepted participants the schedule, venue details, what to bring and the code of conduct.
taskTemplates.nextAction: Draft the briefing message (it is sent only after approval).

taskTemplates.title: Finalize the run of show
taskTemplates.description: Write the minute-by-minute schedule with owners for each slot.
taskTemplates.nextAction: Draft the schedule and share it with all volunteers.

taskTemplates.title: Close out the event
taskTemplates.description: Send thank-you messages, collect feedback, settle supplier invoices and write a short report.
taskTemplates.nextAction: Draft the feedback form before the event so it can go out the day after.

complianceTopics.title: Event permit or activity approval
complianceTopics.description: Public or ticketed events may need an approval from the relevant emirate authority. Check whether this event needs one.

complianceTopics.title: University event policy
complianceTopics.description: Most universities have internal rules for events on campus (booking, security, catering, external guests).

complianceTopics.title: Food safety for catered events
complianceTopics.description: Caterers serving events usually need valid food-handling approvals. Ask caterers for theirs.

complianceTopics.title: Photo and video consent
complianceTopics.description: Decide how consent for photos is collected and respected on the day.

complianceTopics.description: Cash prizes and sponsor-provided prizes may need written terms and payment arrangements.
